groups.tagline: 25 Nights, 26 Days · Moscow, Nizhny Novgorod, Kazan, Yekaterinburg, Novosibirsk, Krasnoyarsk, Irkutsk, Ulan-Ude, Chita, Khabarovsk, Vladivostok

offer.summary: 26 days trip built around Moscow, Nizhny Novgorod, Kazan, Yekaterinburg, Novosibirsk, Krasnoyarsk, Irkutsk, Ulan-Ude, Chita, Khabarovsk, Vladivostok at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Russia journeys we shape by hand through Russia, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you. Price valid for Group tour of min 15 PAX only
highlights: Begin beneath the Kremlin walls at Red Square, where imperial grandeur and Russian history set the tone for the journey.
Discover a historic Volga city crowned by its ancient Kremlin and scenic riverside views.
Experience the meeting of Tatar and Russian cultures through the Kazan Kremlin and the striking Temple of All Religions.
Cross from Europe into Asia in the Ural capital, rich in Romanov history and bold modern culture.
Explore Siberia's energetic capital, set along the broad Ob River and shaped by the railway's enduring spirit.
Escape into the dramatic landscapes of the Yenisey River and Stolby Nature Reserve's striking rock formations.
Wander through elegant wooden architecture before reaching the timeless blue vastness of Lake Baikal.
Encounter the unique blend of Russian and Buryat traditions at the gateway to eastern Siberia and Lake Baikal.
Travel deeper into the remote Trans-Baikal region, where wide steppe landscapes mark the approach to the Far East.
Stroll along the majestic Amur River and experience the refined riverside character of Russia's Far East.
End beside the Sea of Japan in a dramatic Pacific port city of sweeping bays, bridges and maritime charm.

offer.summary: 7 days trip built around Moscow, St Petersburg at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Russia journeys we shape by hand through Russia, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Discover the Kremlin, Red Square and colourful St. Basil's Cathedral at the heart of Russia's historic capital.
Explore the Hermitage and Winter Palace, elegant canals, grand avenues and the city's magnificent imperial architecture.

groups.tagline: 7 Nights, 8 Days · Moscow, Murmansk, Teriberka, Kirovsk, Lovozero

offer.summary: 8 days trip built around Moscow, Murmansk, Teriberka, Kirovsk, Lovozero at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Russia journeys we shape by hand through Russia, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Begin the Aurora hunt beneath Arctic skies, with the city offering a convenient base for clear-night excursions beyond the city lights.
Watch the Northern Lights shimmer above a rugged Arctic coast of frozen shores, sea cliffs and abandoned boats.
Chase vivid auroras beneath the dark Khibiny Mountains, with snowy landscapes perfect for winter adventures.
Experience the Northern Lights in a peaceful tundra setting enriched by Sámi culture, reindeer traditions and wide-open skies.
